objective: The /orbit skill lints records before the PR and ships one records PR per planning cycle. It writes a reconciliation only when a status changes and shows status live.
why: ac8-1 to ac8-5 are not-verified. AgDR-0225 records the owner decision. PR #1620 took four Rex rounds on records and each record is a separate PR today.

include: A records lint script that stops on the first fault. It runs validate; the leak scrub; the sentence check; the Missing and Next rule; the local-path check
/orbit runs the lint before it opens a records PR
The cycle flow in the /orbit skill: cut the slices of a cycle with the Plan revision and open one PR
Reconcile only on a status change. Otherwise the next cycle PR adds one dated line to the Checks section of the plan notes
An /orbit status operation that shows the orbit progress output plus the commits since the observed snapshot commit and writes no record
Tests for the lint on a faulty fixture and for the change-only rule
exclude: Any merge-gate change or Rex exemption for records (rejected in AgDR-0225)
The local viewer and status pane of the owner
Changes to the ORBIT CLI or its schemas
The review tier of records PRs (o7; ac7-1 makes docs/orbit/slices Full because a hook reads it)
